resources.string: A little CRM for friendship. Keep what your friends love, their kids’ names and the dates that matter — all on your device.
Log who you’re with and where. See the last time you were with any group — and who you haven’t seen in a while.
Birthdays, a friend’s surgery, “book tickets with Rui” — gentle reminders at the right time, plus AI ideas for things to do together.
Everything is optional and you can change it later in Settings.
You’re all set — we’ll nudge you at the right time.
Reminders are off. You can turn them on in Settings.
A nudge on birthdays, important days and when it’s been a while.
Explore with sample friends — remove them anytime from Settings.
No account, no server. SMS are never read.
Pick friends from your contacts. The app only sees the people you choose.
Pick friends from your contacts. The app only sees the people you choose, and saves the birthdays, kids, events and notes you add here onto their contact.
We’ll show your contacts so you can tick the friends you want to keep close. Only the people you tick are saved in Good Company. Everyone else stays in your address book, untouched.
Your contacts are read on this phone only and never uploaded.
Pick people one by one instead
Contacts access is off, so we can’t show the list. You can still pick people one at a time.
